subject: STABLE render-lead-opus C6s-kcall: per-job kernel memory churn removed (code cache thrash, client BO pool, snapshot BO) + TEGU_PERF_KCALL_SITE; gate-green; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
ROOT CAUSE (C6r device): mem 4953 / map 4798 per 1678 kernel jobs = ~2.9+2.9 per JOB. The bridge shader-code cache had 16 slots / 8 MiB; CA's steady frames use far more VS/FS binaries (variants, 0.8 MB blur FS), so every miss alloc+mapped a code BO and every eviction unmap+released one. Host repro (old bridge, fake kernel): 40 cycled shaders = 2.00 mem + 2.00 map per draw; client buffer alloc/map/unmap/release = 2+2 per buffer; feedback snapshot draws = 3.9+3.9 per draw.
FIX (nord2_metal_bridge.c): code cache 128 keyed slots (length + 16 sampled words, confirmed by full compare) / 24 MiB, hit/miss/eviction counters; cmdpool 96 entries / 16 MiB; one reused mapped snapshot BO (snapshot path already waits for all GPU work); client BO pool: a released client BO the frontend had mapped stays allocated+mapped (frontend unmap deferred to release) and serves the next ALLOC of the same 16 KiB class, zeroed, once the newest job submitted before its release is reaped (96 entries / 32 MiB / <=4 MiB each; dropped under budget/handle pressure via cmdpool_reclaim, and at close). AFTER, same host repro: 0.00 / 0.04 / 0.00 mem and map per draw/buffer (bridge test CHURN: code 120 draws mem=0 map=0, client 49 frames mem=1 map=1 pool_hits=48, snapshot 20 draws mem=0 map=0). frame_bench pipelined CA loop (FB_CALOOP_KCALL, new) was already ~0.01/job on host before and after (its 4 pipelines never thrashed): host frame_bench cannot show the device churn, the shader-count repro does.
DIAGNOSTIC: TEGU_PERF_KCALL_SITE <ab> site=memN/ms,mapN/ms x top8, printed after TEGU_PERF_KCALL. Sites = bridge path (cmdpool, code, client, clientmap, import, tls, snapshot, heap, clear, chain, reclaim, drawend, other) x frontend path for client buffers (buf, tex, expand, staging, mrtsnap, heap, nocopy); attributes 100% of transport mem/map calls (unattributed -> 'other').
SEMANTIC CHANGES to note: n2mb_unmap of a client BO is a no-op until release (map is idempotent; close unmaps all); n2mb_cmdpool_count includes the snapshot BO; bridge test adjusted for pooling (released mapped BO stays live in the pool; snapshot reuse counted via new n2mb_snapshot_copies).
GATES: run_host_tests all passed (incl ARM64 frontend+bridge, strict link); texture_format PASS; CA PF0/PF1 PASS; render harness PASS; async 7/7; integration = known CA 66/42 only. Root's uncommitted bisect defaults left as they were.
